Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one original standalone knowledge-subject motif for Ben Ebsworth's technical Blog/Lab research folio. A subject-specific illustrative object, not a scientific diagram or an interface.
Medium: refined graphite engraving of a tactile warm-ivory specimen, confident substantial contours, sparse contour-following crosshatching contained inside material surfaces. Quiet authored technical curiosity. Matte ivory, charcoal graphite and one small muted vermilion detail only. No metallic gloss, glow or futuristic embellishment.
Composition: one compact subject on a square canvas, occupying approximately the central 64 percent in both dimensions, with at least 16 percent completely empty margin on every side including every protrusion. All parts inside the frame. Subject-readable silhouette and broad negative spaces. No panel, framing tile, surrounding scene, pedestal unless explicitly part of the specified support, or floor.
Transparency: genuine transparent RGBA background outside the subject and through all open spaces. Warm ivory fills belong only to the physical object. No paper background, white rectangle, checkerboard, ground shadow, vignette, halo, feathered haze or floating specks. Opaque object surfaces with clean antialiased edges.
Constraints: exactly one artwork, no contact sheet or miniatures. No words, letters, numbers, equations, scale marks, diagram labels, fake inscriptions, logos, watermark, ornament borders, decorative arrows or annotation marks. Bold enough to remain identifiable in a 128-pixel full-canvas thumbnail. This is an illustrative metaphor; do not invent data or calibrated scientific geometry.
Subject: an airy three-dimensional spherical state scaffold with exactly ONE broad upright meridian hoop and ONE thinner equatorial hoop at right angles, joined as the minimal open frame of an abstract coordinate sphere. Most of the sphere is clear empty space. A single substantial ivory radial pointer begins at the geometric centre and points upward-right to the outer sphere; only its small triangular tip is muted vermilion. No other pointer, bead or dot. The centre is a simple tiny joint, not a nucleus or clustered object. The frame has restrained hand-engraved volume and coherent three-quarter perspective, with the rear parts quieter than the front. No solid globe, continents, cutaway interior layers, diagonal electron orbits, multiple tilted loops, globe stand, circular lens bezel, base or outside rays. The focal relationship is one orientation within open state space. This is a Bloch-sphere-inspired metaphor, not an atom, physical quantum device, calibrated coordinate diagram or a claim that all quantum processes are rotations.
